args.sql:
SELECT 
    l.stationname AS station_name,
    l.locationtype AS zone_type,
    AVG(ww.waterqualityindex) AS avg_water_quality_index,
    AVG(tswg.powerqualityindex) AS avg_wrmi_score,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN wwcs.classification = 'Needs Water Saving' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS systems_needing_water_saving,
    wwcs.classification,
    wcr.management_situation
FROM 
    location l
JOIN 
    waterandwaste ww ON l.locationregistry = ww.watereqref
JOIN 
    thermalsolarwindandgrid tswg ON l.loceqref = tswg.thermaleqref
LEFT JOIN 
    Water_Quality_Classification_System wwcs ON ww.waterqualityindex = wwcs.index
LEFT JOIN 
    Water_Conservation_Requirement wcr ON l.locationtype = wcr.zone_type
GROUP BY 
    l.stationname, l.locationtype, wwcs.classification, wcr.management_situation
ORDER BY 
    l.stationname, l.locationtype;

    "Water_Quality_Classification_System" wwcs ON ww.waterqualityindex = wwcs.index
LEFT JOIN 
    "Water_Conservation_Requirement" wcr ON l.locationtype = wcr.zone_type
GROUP BY 
    l.stationname, l.locationtype, wwcs.classification, wcr.management_situation
HAVING
    l.stationname, l.locationtype;

SELECT 
    l.stationname AS station_name,
    l.locationtype AS zone_type,
    AVG(ww.waterqualityindex) AS avg_water_quality_index,
    AVG(tswg.powerqualityindex) AS avg_wrmi_score,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN wwcs.classification = 'Needs Water Saving' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS systems_needing_water_saving,
    wwcs.classification,
    wcr.management_situation
FROM 
    location l
JOIN 
    waterandwaste ww ON l.locationregistry = ww.watereqref::integer
JOIN 
    thermalsolarwindandgrid tswg ON l.loceqref = tswg.thermaleqref
LEFT JOIN 
    "Water_Quality_Classification_System" wwcs ON ww.waterqualityindex = wwcs.index
LEFT JOIN 
    "Water_Conservation_Requirement" wcr ON l.locationtype = wcr.zone_type
GROUP BY 
    l.stationname, l.locationtype, wwcs.classification, wcr.management_situation
ORDER BY 
    l.stationname, l.locationtype;
